title: Positions table (words only)
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Summer 1: Salah and praying in congregation
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y4 lesson 21 (Pupil PDF worksheet: positions table (words only))
intro: Lesson 21: The pillars of salah (2): ruku', sujud, sitting, tashahhud and salam. To understand the remaining pillars of salah and why we must be calm in each position

questions.q: Order these: salam, ruku', sujud, tashahhud.
questions.model: Teacher: 'Bow first (ruku'), then sujud, then sit for the tashahhud, then end with salam.'

questions.q: How many body parts touch the ground in sujud?
On the pupil PDF, complete the positions table: for each position write its name, what the body does and what we say in it.
questions.a: Ruku': Subhana Rabbiyal-'Adhim; sujud: Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la; sitting: Rabbighfir li; tashahhud; salam
questions.model: Teacher labels the bowing shape: 'Ruku': Subhana Rabbiyal-'Adhim.'

questions.q: name the seven body parts of sujud.
questions.a: Forehead with nose, two hands, two knees, two feet (toes)

questions.q: why did the Prophet ﷺ tell the man to pray again?
questions.a: He rushed and was not calm; tuma'ninah is a pillar

questions.q: Back to our ponder: when are we closest to Allah?
